methodology.best_model: Model-screened research, not a validated betting edge. Includes legacy qualified selections; no outcome-driven deletion.
methodology.best_value: Non-alternate selections independently qualified against reference-book prices.
methodology.all_projection: One line per event, player, market and side, chosen closest to standard -110 pricing.
methodology.going_picks_v1: Football-case-v1: first prospective rating/badges/evidence frozen separately. Priced contracts enter the $100 research record; missing prices remain research receipts without ROI. No backfill or demonstrated pricing edge.
methodology.going_picks_v2: Football-case-v2: /100 evidence bands with within-band directional projection-gap/model-spread refinement. Separate prospective cohort; v1 receipts stay unchanged. Heuristic, not probability or proven value.
methodology.closing_prices: Scheduled same-book/exact-line observations from existing pulls. Only samples within 10 minutes are labeled near kickoff; the twice-daily schedule cannot guarantee closing coverage.

summary.limitations: Prospective selections only; no retroactive winners. Results use published full-game outcomes. Book-specific void and injury rules are not inferred. Public research is separate from user-entered bets.

settlement_audit.note: Missing player participation is not zero and does not establish book-specific void rules.

result_coverage.method: Published finals compared with any original pregame selection; untracked finals never create retrospective bets

calibration_audit.method: Chronological replay, trained strictly before each original forecast; equal game weights, no cross-cohort training.
calibration_audit.promotion_rule: No automatic promotion. Require prospective same-cohort evidence across later weeks, game-cluster uncertainty and a same-book devigged benchmark.

workload_audit.method: Algebraic error attribution using frozen opportunity counts; positive error means overprojection, not a causal explanation. Missing/zero opportunity denominators are excluded.

picks_research.note: Football thesis results are separate from priced $100 predictions. Unknown prices never create ROI.
